# docs/_static/

Static assets served by the Sphinx documentation site. All files here are logo artwork generated by `docs/make_logo.py`.

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `logo.svg` | Full wordmark (mark + "plantbench" text) for light backgrounds. |
| `logo-dark.svg` | Full wordmark for dark backgrounds. |
| `logo-mark.svg` | Mark only (the spiral) for light backgrounds. |
| `logo-mark-dark.svg` | Mark only for dark backgrounds. |
| `logo.pdf` | PDF version of the full wordmark for print use. |
